beats.care: Her first series as captain starts 16 Oct against Zimbabwe in Raipur. Harmanpreet keeps playing.
beats.what: Smriti Mandhana is the new full-time captain of India's women's cricket team.
beats.why: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down after leading India to last year's ODI World Cup title.

cards.body: On 6 Oct, Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down as captain of the India women's cricket team. The BCCI named Smriti Mandhana as the new full-time captain.
In 2024 and 2026. She's also captained India 22 times before as a stand-in.
cards.caption: WPL trophies Smriti won as RCB captain

cards.body: Harmanpreet led India to its first-ever ODI World Cup title last year. So Smriti is taking over a champion team, and everyone's watching.
cards.title: why is this a big deal?

cards.body: Harmanpreet isn't leaving the team. She'll keep playing, which means the old captain will be in the dressing room with the new one.
Smriti's first series as full-time captain is at home against Zimbabwe, starting 16 Oct in Raipur.
cards.title: when can I watch?

cards.q: Which WPL team did Smriti captain to two titles?
cards.why: She led Royal Challengers Bengaluru to WPL titles in 2024 and 2026.

cards.q: Will India win every T20 against Zimbabwe?

hook: India's women's team has a new captain. *Who* and why now?
